name: Silver Talons / real base attack with false grant condition
printed_text: When this attacks a hero, if it is Draconic, you may have target dagger you control deal 1 damage to them. If damage is dealt this way, the dagger has hit. Destroy the dagger.

name: Infectious Host / real base attack with false grant condition
printed_text: When this attacks a hero, if you control a Frailty token, create a Frailty token under their control, then repeat for Inertia and Bloodrot Pox.

name: Escalate Order / real base attack with false grant condition
printed_text: When this attacks, if you control a Toughness token, create 3 more.
